environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with an associated CloudFront distribution. The CloudFront distribution has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that appends 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'' to ALL origin responses. The ALB target group has sticky sessions DISABLED. CloudFront origin request policy strips query string parameter 'sid' via a custom origin request policy with QueryStringBehavior set to 'allExcept' excluding 'sid'. The ECS task role has no additional permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch logs.
